title: Symbol AS2 linkage (exportForActionScript/className) not read from binary FLA
description: When opening a binary Flash 8 .fla, SymbolLinkage fields (exportForActionScript, className, linkageIdentifier) are never extracted. The binary parser has no path to read ExportAssets linkage data. Any symbol with Export for ActionScript loses its attachMovie identifier and class name, breaking all AS2 attachMovie/new ClassName() patterns from imported documents.
